$description: Structure: the eight timber grades of Yingzao Fashi (材分八等). Each grade is the height of its 材 in 寸. A part's grade sets how heavy it is: its motion duration is the grade's height times the finish's grade unit (motion.grade-unit). Shared by every finish.

1.$description: First grade, 9 寸. The heaviest timber: Dialog and the exploded view.

3.$description: Third grade, 7.5 寸. Card and other content surfaces.

5.$description: Fifth grade, 6.6 寸. Floating overlays: Menu, Select and Combobox popups.

7.$description: Seventh grade, 5.25 寸. Controls: Button, IconButton, Tabs and Progress, and focus brackets.

8.$description: Eighth grade, 4.5 寸. The lightest timber: the Switch face.
